subject.title: fix: keep newline-mode reply paragraphs as separate channel bubbles

question: Should `chunkMode: "newline"` become a cross-channel guarantee that every top-level blank-line paragraph is sent separately, even when existing deliveries would previously pack those paragraphs below the transport limit?
rationale: The implementation fixes the reported Codex/WhatsApp symptom at the shared outbound boundary, but that intentionally changes message grouping for every existing newline-mode channel configuration rather than only correcting the Codex projection path.

options.title: Adopt separate-paragraph delivery
options.body: Accept the global newline-mode semantics and require live WhatsApp proof plus release-context documentation of the changed grouping behavior before merge.

options.title: Scope the repair more narrowly
options.body: Keep existing generic newline packing and implement a proven runtime-specific boundary fix if maintainers do not want to alter message grouping for other newline-mode users.

recommendation.title: Adopt separate-paragraph delivery
recommendation.body: Accept the global newline-mode semantics and require live WhatsApp proof plus release-context documentation of the changed grouping behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner could not be established from the supplied review context; the decision belongs with the outbound/reply-runtime ownership group.
